Clanker
CR 8

A metallic sphere balanced on two legs rolls into view, its single eye- like sensor flickering erratically as sparks dance across its battered surface, arms twitching with an unsettling mixture of purpose and confusion.

XP 4,800
N Medium construct
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +14

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 12, flat-footed 20 (+2 Dex, +10 natural)
hp 92 (8d10+50)
Fort +2, Ref +4, Will +4; DR 5/adamantine; Immune construct traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 2 slams +14 (2d6+6)
Ranged energy blast +10 (3d6 electricity)
Special Attacks unpredictable assault

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 14, Con –, Int 10, Wis 13, Cha 1
Base Atk +8; CMB +14, CMD 26
Feats Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Weapon Focus (slam), Vital Strike
Skills Climb +14, Perception +14, Survival +12
Languages Common (cannot speak)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Energy Blast (Ex)

The Klanker can fire a blast of electrical energy as a standard action with a range of 60 feet.

Unpredictable Assault (Ex)

Once per round, when the Klanker makes an attack roll, it can roll twice and take the better result. However, on a natural 1, the Klanker must reroll its attack against the nearest creature (friend or foe).

Corrupted Programming (Ex)

The Klanker is immune to mind-affecting effects, but its actions are sometimes erratic. At the start of its turn, there’s a 10% chance it will act randomly for that round (determined by the GM.)

ECOLOGY

Environment any arid
Organization solitary, pair, or troop (3–8)
Treasure Standard

Klankers are the remnants of a once-advanced robotic workforce, now driven by corrupted AI and incomplete directives. These spherical constructs stand about 5 feet tall, with two articulated arms ending in multi-tool appendages and a pair of sturdy legs for locomotion. Their metallic bodies are scarred and pitted from years of neglect, yet they continue to function with an eerie persistence.

The Klanker’s spherical main body houses a complex array of sensors, giving it an unsettling, alien appearance.

Its “face” is a featureless panel with a single, glowing optical sensor that shifts in color based on its current task or emotional state – a haunting reminder of its former sophistication. Occasionally, sparks of electricity crackle across its surface, hinting at the powerful energy source contained within.

Despite their damaged programming, Klankers retain fragments of their original purpose as maintenance and repair units. This often manifests in bizarrely juxtaposed behaviors, such as attempting to “repair” living creatures or treating organic matter as mechanical components. Their actions are unpredictable, ranging from docile curiosity to sudden, violent outbursts.

The true number of Klankers in existence remains unknown, but given the immense size of their original vessel, it’s feared that a significant population may be scattered across the land, each one a potential threat or unlikely ally, depending on the quirks of its corrupted programming.
